title: Run Meta Record
description: A versioned record of one thing an SDLC engine run observed about itself, recovered or captured outside the normal state-file lifecycle. First consumer: work-assertion bails recovered from historical runs and replayed as fixtures (BT.ticket.work-assertion-cannot-express-a-correct-empty-intersection) — extracted by scripts/extract_bail_meta_fixtures.py into scripts/fixtures/bail_meta/work_assertion/, and read by both engines' own fixture suite plus engine-rs's EN.ticket.verify-claimed-writes-matches-the-js-work-assertion. `kind` is a closed enum on purpose — only 'bail' is defined yet. A future kind is added by extending the enum and adding its own sibling object next to `bail` (e.g. a `retry` object), never by loosening `bail` itself or by building a generic kind registry ahead of a second real consumer.

schema_version.description: Format version of this record shape. Starts at 1; bump on any breaking change to the `bail` object below (a field renamed or its type changed — an additive optional field does not require a bump).

kind.description: Which sibling object on this record is populated. Only 'bail' is defined yet — do not add other enum values speculatively; add one only when a second real record shape exists to populate it.

bail.description: Populated when kind is 'bail'. One recorded work-assertion bail (or a synthetic fixture built to the same shape), holding exactly what scripts/extract_bail_meta_fixtures.py can recover deterministically from a source state file and this repo's git history — never an invented or interpolated value.

repo.description: Repo slug the bailed run executed in, as registered in brain.toml (e.g. 'base-template').

task_id.description: The task_id (sdlc-task) or task number (sdlc-flow) that bailed, exactly as recorded on the source state file.

commit_range.description: OPTIONAL. The commit range the work assertion evaluated for this bail (e.g. 'HEAD~1..HEAD' or '<prevSha>..HEAD'), when the source state file records enough to reconstruct it. Absent when unrecoverable — recovery must not guess this value.

name_status.description: The literal `git diff --name-status` lines for this bail's commit range, one line per array entry. Empty array is a valid, meaningful value (an empty-diff bail) — it is never used as a stand-in for 'unrecoverable'.

declared_files.description: The bailed task's own files[] at bail time, read from the source state file's recorded task-spec snapshot.

task_kind.description: Coarse classification of what the task was trying to do, used to interpret an empty diff. 'validate-only' when the task's declared files[] was empty; 'code-change' otherwise.

validation_exit_codes.description: OPTIONAL. Maps each validation command string the source state file recorded for this bail to its observed exit code. Empty object when the source recorded none — never fabricated.

primary_class.description: OPTIONAL. Carried through verbatim from the source bail-classification record's own primary_class field, for traceability back to the classification this fixture was recovered from.

specific_rule.description: OPTIONAL. Carried through verbatim from the source bail-classification record's own specific_rule field.

source.description: Repo-relative or HQ-vault-relative path to the sdlc-task-state.json / sdlc-flow-state.json (or bail-classification record) this fixture was extracted from — the provenance trail back to the original evidence.
